text: There is smoke coming from the house next door at 14 Elm Street.
My neighbour fell and she cannot get up. She is 80. We are at 3 Pine Road.
Now I can see flames and I think people are trapped inside.
Someone scratched my car outside 9 Birch Lane last night.
A man is waving a knife at people outside the shop at 22 Oak Avenue.
Never mind, nobody is hurt, it can wait until tomorrow.
